name: 📸 旅行照片大片重塑 (Cinematography Retouch)

prompt_template: cinematic masterpiece, {subject}, shot on Leica M6 35mm f/1.4, Kodak Portra 400 film grain, golden hour warm side lighting, soft lens flare, clean background with clutter removed, DaVinci Resolve color grading, 8k uhd
